title: Former Gov. George Pataki releasing new Ground Zero documentary: ‘9/11 wasn’t some sort of an accident. It was a terrorist attack ‘
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

The George Pataki Center is releasing a new documentary chronicling the rebuilding of Ground Zero to honor the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

“9/11 wasn’t some sort of an accident. It was a terrorist attack carried out by radical Islamists who wanted to take away our freedom and force us to live in fear,” the former Republican Gov., who served during the attacks and whose Albany-based nonprofit is funding the flick, told The Post.

“Out of the Darkness” chronicles the Empire State’s rebuilding process and process to provide a memorial spot for the nearly 3,000 people killed and will be available to screen for free on the center’s website after the Thursday premiere.

John Castimatidis, the billionaire owner of Gristedes supermarkets, will be honoring the former governor with “The Leadership Crisis Award”, recognizing his efforts during and after the attack at an upcoming memorial gala.

“Everybody, not just in New York, but around the country had an opinion as to what should be done,” Pataki said.

“And we had to cut through all those emotions, which was hard to do and just keep our eye on the vision as to what we wanted to end up with there. And it worked out extremely well.”
